product.ta-10-2.summary: The TA 10/2 let operators change programs without opening the electronics cabinet.
product.ta-10-2.history: Triumph-Adler positioned it as the accounting model in the TA 10 range. The desk combined the writing mechanism, a separate numeric keypad and a replaceable program cassette.
product.ta-10-2.technical.configuration: Operators changed tasks by replacing the cassette. The manual locates the module behind a lockable cover on the left side of the desk.
product.ta-10-2.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-10-2.technical.limitations: The program from an identified unit and an operating test remain pending.
